title: odd-tabs
description: Tabs that switch between related panels (APG tabs). Panels are `odd-tab-panel` children; the element draws a tab for each and assigns each panel to a tab panel inside its own shadow root (manual slot assignment), so each tab and its panel reference each other while the content stays in the light DOM.
$comment: Slots: default. A child names a slot with "slot"; text and children without "slot" go to the default slot.

value.description: The selected panel's `value` (its position when it has none). Without a match, the first enabled panel shows.

orientation.description: Tabs in a row above the panel, or in a column beside it.

activation.description: Select a tab when it receives focus, or only with Enter or Space (APG).
